```{r}
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(blockCV)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(yardstick)
library(ggplot2)

```


```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# DEFINE IPDW CV FUNCTION
# --------------------------------------------------


ipdw_run <- function(
    df,
    dist_pwr,
    folds,
    max_range = 10000,
    value_col = "mean"
) {

  ipdw_cv <- purrr::map_dfr(
    seq_along(folds$folds_list),
    function(i) {

      train_idx <- folds$folds_list[[i]][[1]]
      test_idx  <- folds$folds_list[[i]][[2]]

      train <- df[train_idx, ]
      test  <- df[test_idx, ]

      # Interpolate using training stations
      ipdw_result <- ipdw_manual(
        train,
        cost_raster,
        max_range,
        value_col,
        dist_power = dist_pwr
      )

      # Convert to SpatRaster
      ipdw_raster <- terra::rast(ipdw_result)

      # Extract predictions at validation locations
      predicted <- terra::extract(
        ipdw_raster,
        terra::vect(test),
        ID = FALSE
      )[[1]]

      tibble::tibble(
        fold = i,
        observed = test[[value_col]],
        predicted = predicted
      )
    }
  )

  # Accuracy metrics
  ipdw_cv %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      dist_power = dist_pwr,
      max_range = max_range,
      n = dplyr::n(),
      n_valid = sum(is.finite(predicted)),
      MAE = yardstick::mae_vec(
        observed, predicted, na_rm = TRUE
      ),
      RMSE = yardstick::rmse_vec(
        observed, predicted, na_rm = TRUE
      ),
      Bias = mean(
        predicted - observed, na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )
}


```

```{r}

# --------------------------------------------------
# DEFINE FUNCTION TO TEST MODEL SENSITIVITY AGAINST DISTANCE POWER
# --------------------------------------------------

distance_power_test <- function(
    df,
    n_seeds = 5,
    value_col = "mean",
    unit = "",
    max_range = 10000,
    block_size = 5000,
    dist_powers = c(0.25, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3)
) {

  # Generate folds and run IPDW
  cv_sensitivity <- purrr::map_dfr(
    seq_len(n_seeds),
    function(s) {

      set.seed(s)

      folds <- blockCV::cv_spatial(
        x = df,
        k = 5,
        size = block_size,
        selection = "random",
        plot = FALSE
      )

      # Evaluate every distance-power parameter
      purrr::map_dfr(
        dist_powers,
        \(p) ipdw_run(
          df = df,
          dist_pwr = p,
          max_range = max_range,
          folds = folds,
          value_col = value_col
        )
      ) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(seed = s)
    }
  )

  # Summarize across partitions
  cv_summary <- cv_sensitivity %>%
    dplyr::group_by(dist_power) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      mean_MAE = mean(MAE),
      sd_MAE = sd(MAE),
      mean_RMSE = mean(RMSE),
      sd_RMSE = sd(RMSE),
      mean_Bias = mean(Bias),
      min_coverage = min(n_valid / n),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(mean_MAE)

  # Count parameter wins
  parameter_wins <- cv_sensitivity %>%
    dplyr::group_by(seed) %>%
    dplyr::slice_min(MAE, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::count(dist_power, name = "wins") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(wins))

  # Plot cross-validation accuracy
  cv_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    cv_sensitivity,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = dist_power,
      y = MAE,
      group = factor(seed)
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(alpha = 0.4) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    ggplot2::stat_summary(
      ggplot2::aes(group = 1),
      fun = mean,
      geom = "line",
      linewidth = 1.2,
      color = "red"
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = "IPDW Distance-Power Sensitivity",
      subtitle = paste(
        n_seeds, "random partitions, 5 spatial folds each"
      ),
      x = "Distance Power",
      y = paste0(
        "Mean Absolute Error",
        if (nzchar(unit)) paste0(" (", unit, ")")
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal()

  # Return all results
  list(
    summary = cv_summary,
    raw_results = cv_sensitivity,
    parameter_wins = parameter_wins,
    plot = cv_plot
  )
}

```


Test different Max Ranges

```{r}

library(sf)
library(terra)
library(blockCV)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(yardstick)
library(ggplot2)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define IPDW cross-validation function
# --------------------------------------------------

ipdw_range_cv <- function(max_range, folds, dist_pwr = 1.5) {

  ipdw_cv <- purrr::map_dfr(
    seq_along(folds$folds_list),
    function(i) {

      # Identify training and validation stations
      train_idx <- folds$folds_list[[i]][[1]]
      test_idx  <- folds$folds_list[[i]][[2]]

      train <- sal_cv[train_idx, ]
      test  <- sal_cv[test_idx, ]

      # Run IPDW using training stations only
      ipdw_result <- ipdw_manual(
        train,
        cost_raster,
        max_range,
        "mean",
        dist_power = dist_pwr
      )

      # Convert result to SpatRaster
      ipdw_raster <- terra::rast(ipdw_result)

      # Extract predictions at validation stations
      predicted <- terra::extract(
        ipdw_raster,
        terra::vect(test),
        ID = FALSE
      )[[1]]

      tibble::tibble(
        fold = i,
        observed = test$mean,
        predicted = predicted
      )
    }
  )

  # Calculate accuracy metrics
  ipdw_cv %>%
    summarise(
      max_range = max_range,
      dist_power = dist_pwr,
      n = n(),
      n_valid = sum(is.finite(predicted)),
      coverage = n_valid / n,
      MAE = yardstick::mae_vec(
        observed, predicted, na_rm = TRUE
      ),
      RMSE = yardstick::rmse_vec(
        observed, predicted, na_rm = TRUE
      ),
      Bias = mean(
        predicted - observed, na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )
}


# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Set parameters
# --------------------------------------------------

path_ranges <- c(5000, 7500, 10000, 15000, 20000)

dist_pwr <- 1.5

seeds <- 1:5


# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Run repeated spatial cross-validation
# --------------------------------------------------

range_sensitivity <- purrr::map_dfr(seeds, function(s) {

  set.seed(s)

  folds <- blockCV::cv_spatial(
    x = sal_cv,
    k = 5,
    size = 5000,
    selection = "random",
    plot = FALSE
  )

  purrr::map_dfr(
    path_ranges,
    \(r) ipdw_range_cv(
      max_range = r,
      folds = folds,
      dist_pwr = dist_pwr
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(seed = s)
})


# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Summarize results across partitions
# --------------------------------------------------

range_summary <- range_sensitivity %>%
  group_by(max_range) %>%
  summarise(
    dist_power = first(dist_power),
    mean_MAE = mean(MAE),
    sd_MAE = sd(MAE),
    mean_RMSE = mean(RMSE),
    sd_RMSE = sd(RMSE),
    mean_Bias = mean(Bias),
    min_coverage = min(coverage),
    mean_coverage = mean(coverage),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(min_coverage), mean_MAE)

print(range_summary)


# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Identify best range for each partition
# --------------------------------------------------

best_range_by_seed <- range_sensitivity %>%
  group_by(seed) %>%
  arrange(desc(coverage), MAE, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()

print(best_range_by_seed)


# --------------------------------------------------
# 6. Count how often each range performed best
# --------------------------------------------------

range_wins <- best_range_by_seed %>%
  count(max_range, name = "wins") %>%
  arrange(desc(wins))

print(range_wins)


# --------------------------------------------------
# 7. Plot performance across maximum path distances
# --------------------------------------------------

ggplot(
  range_sensitivity,
  aes(
    x = max_range / 1000,
    y = MAE,
    group = factor(seed)
  )
) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.4, color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "grey50") +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = 1),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "line",
    linewidth = 1.2,
    color = "red"
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = 1),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    size = 3,
    color = "red"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "IPDW Maximum Path Distance Sensitivity",
    subtitle = "5 partitions, 5 spatial folds, distance power = 1.5",
    x = "Maximum Path Distance (km)",
    y = "Mean Absolute Error (ppt)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


```
